created.description: The date and time the creation of the instance was triggered.

description.description: A user chosen description to distinguish multiple instances.

displayName.description: The displayed name of the instance.

frontendUrl.description: URL to the Management UI of the Instance.

id.description: A auto generated unique id which identifies the instance.

planId.description: Service Plan configures the size of the Instance.

status.description: The current status of the instance.

acl.description: The ACL config for the instances API.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the entry was created.

ipRange.description: The IP CIDR range for the ACL entry.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the entry was last updated.

uuid.description: The unique identifier for the ipAllowListEntry entry. This value is immutable, used to identify entries for updates, and cannot be changed after creation.
